senses.gloss: भोग- + आवास भोग- + आवास, m. the harem.
भोग- + कर भोग- + कर, adj., f. री, procuring food, Bhartṛ. 2, 17.
भोगकर भोग-कर, adj., f. री, Affording enjoyment, Bhartṛ. 2, 17.
भोग- + गृह भोग- + गृह, n. the inner apartment, the harem.
भोग- + पति भोग- + पति, m. 1. a viceroy, a governor. 2. a person having possession or usufruct.
भोग- + पाल भोग- + पाल, m. a groom.

भोग भोग, i. e. 1. and 2. भुज् + अ, m.
 1. A snake's body, Utt. Rāmac. 43, 4.
 2. A snake.
 3. A snake's expanded hood, Pañc. ii. d. 131; feasting, Hit. army in column.
 5. Nourishing, cherishing, food, Bhag. 2, 5.
 6. Pleasure, Rām. 3, 53, 3.
 7. Enjoyment, Bhartṛ. 2, 35; Pañc. ii. d. 131; feasting, Hit. ii. d. 99.
 8. Adverse enjoyment (usufruct), Man. 8, 149.
 9. Possession.
 10. Wealth.
 11. Hire.
 12. The hire of dancing girls.
 --Comp.

भोगवन्त् भोग + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती.
 1. Having enjoyment.
 2. Delightful.
 II. m.
 1. A snake.
 2. Dancing.
 3. Singing.
 III. f. वती,
 1. The capital of the snakes, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 15.
 2. The Gaṅgā of the lower regions.
भोगार्ह भोगार्ह, i. e. भोग-अर्ह, n. Wealth.
भोगिक भोगिक, i. e. भोग + इक, n. A groom.

भोगिन् भोगिन्, i. e. भोग + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Enjoying.
 2. Abounding in enjoyments, Bhag. 16, 14.
 3. Having enjoyments and an expanded [] hood, Pañc. i. d. 73.
 II. m.
 1. A snake, Bhartṛ. 2, 82.
 2. A king, Hit. iii. d. 58.
 3. The head man of a village.
 4. A barber.
 5. A person who accumulates money for a particular expenditure.
 III. f. नी.
 1. The capital of the serpents.
 2. A royal concubine.
 --Comp.
भोग- + सद्मन् भोग- + सद्मन्, n. the zenana.
